bullets.text: Under course project supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided public policy records and used unittest to test transformations on hand-checked input examples.
Under supervision, applied a documented topic dictionary to provided public policy document samples using NLTK and checked dictionary matches against manually reviewed examples.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize changes in group comparisons under alternative cleaning rules.
As part of supervised research, implemented reusable Python modules for the public research abstract workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under research supervision, applied a documented topic dictionary to provided public research abstract samples using NLTK and checked dictionary matches against manually reviewed examples.
Under research supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
